_why: Which doc describes which part of the code, so nothing has to be remembered.
I have asked more times for the docs to be kept current than for anything else,
and every previous answer was a promise to remember. This is the mechanism that
replaces the promise: scripts/doc-check.mjs reads the diff, maps the changed
files through this file, and names the docs that describe them. CI fails when a
commit touches mapped code and carries no doc link, so the absence is visible
THE BOARD IS THE TRACKER. It is `always` because it is where I read what is next
and what is done — it is not one doc among nine, it is the one that must never be
behind. Every piece of work that lands touches it.
Retired artifacts are deliberately NOT in this list. They are frozen signposts;
updating one would be the drift this file exists to stop.
The human-readable version of this file is the Docs Plan page, generated from
it by scripts/build-docs-plan.mjs. The page and the gate therefore cannot
disagree: there is one source, and the page is a rendering of it.

docs.name: Leads Build board
docs.why: The tracker: every task with its status, next step and what was done. Update the TASK, with a note of what was actually done.

docs.name: Master Plan
docs.why: The phase sequence. It has to agree with the board — two docs disagreeing about the same phase is the confusion the board exists to prevent.

docs.name: Leads Design Standard
docs.why: THE design authority for any lead surface — row, tiles, toolbar, peek, record. Every disagreement resolves here.

docs.name: Every Leads Page
docs.why: What each individual lead surface is for and which tiles it carries. Shape right / content wrong is the mistake this one catches.

docs.name: Live Samples
docs.why: How a shared component actually looks, at full size. If the built page and this deck disagree about looks, the deck wins.

docs.name: UI-Kit
docs.why: The shared component inventory. A component is not done until a page imports it.

docs.name: GHL Integration
docs.why: Every GoHighLevel endpoint in use, which function owns it, and which way the data flows. Never invent a response shape — check docs/ghl/ first.

docs.name: Design vs Build
docs.why: Where the running app and the design disagree TODAY. Closing a gap means closing its row here, in the same session.

docs.name: Shipped log
docs.why: The record of what is actually live. An item lands here the moment it deploys, not when it is committed.

_excludesWhy: Ops panels, push buttons and helpers share src/components/admin/leads/** with the actual design surfaces. The four design docs describe the row, tiles, toolbar, peek and record — not a backfill panel or a push button. The gate named all four on five commits in two days and was waived every time, which is how a gate stops being one. The broad glob stays so a NEW surface file is covered by default; only known non-surfaces are listed, and adding one here is a deliberate act.
